errors.busy: omp has a menu open. Close it in the terminal sheet before running another action.

permission.title: How much omp may do
permission.tooltip: How much omp may do on its own before asking you.
permission.scopeNote: Saved for this project. It applies to open chats too.

always-ask.label: Ask me first
always-ask.description: omp asks before editing files or running commands.

write.label: Edits OK
write.description: omp can edit project files; it asks before running commands.

yolo.label: Auto
yolo.description: omp can edit files and run commands without asking.

autoConfirm.title: Let omp run on its own?
autoConfirm.description: Auto lets omp run commands without asking. Only use it in projects you trust.

model.title: Choose a model
model.tooltip: Choose which AI model answers you.
model.empty: No matching models. Try a shorter search.
model.scopeNote: This chat only. New chats use your default model.

thinking.title: Thinking
thinking.tooltip: Choose how much time the model spends thinking before it answers.
thinking.unsupported: This model has no adjustable thinking levels.
thinking.failed: omp could not switch to that thinking level.

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: omp picks the effort for each question.

minimal.label: Minimal
minimal.description: Quick answers with a little extra thought.

low.label: Low
low.description: A light pass for simpler tasks.

high.label: High
high.description: Think more carefully through harder tasks.

max.label: Max
max.description: Use the model's highest thinking effort.

chip.tooltip: Choose a permission level or turn on a work mode.

restart.title: Restart omp
restart.hint: Start omp's engine over. Your chat history is kept.

compact.title: Compact this chat
compact.hint: Summarize this chat so far to free up working room.

plan.title: Plan mode
plan.hint: Think through an approach and show a plan before changing anything.

goal.title: Set a goal
goal.hint: Describe the finish line; omp plans the steps and works toward it.

guided.title: Guided goal
guided.hint: Let omp interview you and set up a goal.

vibe.title: Vibe mode
vibe.hint: Direct quick helper sessions to build things fast.

loop.title: Repeat a task
loop.hint: Repeat a task a set number of times, for a while, or until a check passes.

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.hint: A second model watches each step and adds notes when something looks off.

handoff.title: Hand off to a new chat
handoff.hint: Start a fresh chat that picks up from a summary of this one.

security.title: Security scan
security.hint: Check the project for leaked secrets and common vulnerabilities.

cleanse.title: Cleanse project
cleanse.hint: Find and fix errors and warnings across the project with parallel helpers.

export.title: Export chat
export.hint: Save this chat as a web page you can open anywhere.

rename.title: Rename chat
rename.hint: Give this chat a name you'll recognize later.

model.title: Choose model
model.hint: Choose which AI model answers you.

tree.title: Branch tree
tree.hint: See every fork and rewind of this chat as a map.

fork.title: Fork chat
fork.hint: Branch this chat to try a different direction without losing this one.

rewind.title: Rewind to here
rewind.hint: Go back to this point and keep the original path as a branch.

forkFrom.title: Fork from here
forkFrom.hint: Try a different direction from this message without losing this chat.

compact.title: Summarize this chat
compact.description: Summarize the conversation to free up working room. Add a focus if there is something omp should keep in mind.
compact.label: What should omp focus on? (optional)

handoff.title: Hand off this chat
handoff.description: omp writes a summary and starts a fresh chat with the same context.
handoff.label: What should the next chat focus on? (optional)

rename.title: Rename this chat
rename.description: Choose a short name that's easy to find later.
rename.label: Chat name

guided.title: Set up a guided goal
guided.description: Share a rough objective. omp will ask a few questions, then set up a goal.
guided.label: What would you like to accomplish? (optional)

goal.title: Work toward a goal
goal.description: Describe the finish line; omp plans the steps and works toward it.
goal.budgetHint: A positive number, or leave blank for no limit.
goal.guided: Let omp help me shape the goal
goal.activeBody: This chat has an active goal. You can pause it or drop it.
goal.pausedBody: This chat has a paused goal. Resume it to continue, or drop it.

loop.title: Repeat a task
loop.description: omp repeats your next request until the limit or check is reached. Esc pauses the loop.
loop.promptHint: Leave blank to repeat the next request you send.

security.disabled: Security scanning is turned off in omp settings.

plan.missing: The plan file is not available yet.
plan.exitDescription: This leaves plan mode without approving the current plan.

done.execute: Plan approved. omp is starting the work.
done.compact: Plan approved. omp is summarizing the chat first.
done.keep: Plan approved with the full chat context.
done.refine: Plan saved. Add a note in the composer to refine it.
done.save: Plan saved. omp has finished this chat.

tree.title: Session tree
tree.description: Every branch of this chat, from its first message to the current point.
tree.emptyHint: Start a chat and its branches will appear here.
tree.selectHint: Select a message to preview it.
tree.noBranches: No branches yet — fork a chat to explore a different approach.
tree.noText: This entry has no message text.

navigate.noFile: This chat does not have a saved session file yet.
navigate.busy: Wait for the current response to finish before moving to another point.
navigate.missing: That message is no longer in this chat.
navigate.unsupported: That entry cannot be opened from the conversation tree.
navigate.notFound: omp could not find that message in its tree. The original chat is unchanged.
navigate.unconfirmed: omp did not confirm the tree move. The original chat is unchanged.
navigate.forkTimeout: omp did not finish switching sessions in time.
